Container.Name: subwave-gossip-companion
Container.Overview: Persona-aware fictional gossip companion for SUB/WAVE. Serves /gossip.rss?show=&actor= so each speaking character gets show-known rumors, skips the rumor they most recently voiced, and receives a gossipTeller name when that teller is on the show. Spoken events and TTS follow-ups record comments. Persistent state, prompt, and LLM call logs are stored below the workspace path. The repository field pins image tag v1.0.0 so an upgrade is a deliberate edit. Read CHANGELOG.md before changing it. The floating tag latest follows main and is not a rollback point. GOSSIP_FEED_BASE_URL must be a URL the Subwave host can fetch, for example http://192.168.1.20:8080 on the LAN or http://subwave-gossip-companion:8080 on a shared Docker network. Do not leave it as the container loopback. Set Extra Parameters to --stop-timeout=15 because the default 10 second Docker stop grace is shorter than the 5000 ms shutdown deadline plus the state lock wait.

Config.Description: Gossip companion HTTP port.

Config.Name: SUBWAVE_API_TOKEN
Config.Description: SUB/WAVE HTTP Basic credential (base64 of user:password).

Config.Name: PROVIDER
Config.Description: LLM provider: openai, google, or anthropic.

Config.Name: PROVIDER_KEY
Config.Description: LLM provider API key.

Config.Description: LLM model name.

Config.Name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_REFRESH_SECRET
Config.Description: Required dedicated operator secret for refresh HTTP requests.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_REFRESH_MAX_CONCURRENCY
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous refreshes (1-10).

Config.Name: GOSSIP_REFRESH_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
Config.Description: Minimum milliseconds between admitted refreshes (0-3600000).

Config.Name: GOSSIP_FEED_BASE_URL
Config.Description: URL Subwave uses to fetch this container. Example: http://192.168.1.20:8080 or http://subwave-gossip-companion:8080. Not the container loopback.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_REVIEW_ROUNDS
Config.Description: Post-generation edit passes, integer 0-5.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_SOUL_SUMMARY
Config.Description: 1 compresses each persona soul before seed or refresh. 0 skips that and sends the full soul.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_TTS_TIMEOUT_MS
Config.Description: How long serve waits for a spoken clip, in milliseconds.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_TTS_POLL_MS
Config.Description: Spoken-clip poll interval in milliseconds, at least 250.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_LLM_CALL_LOG
Config.Description: LLM call log under the workspace. Empty disables it.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_LLM_LOG_CONTENT
Config.Description: off, metadata, or full. metadata drops prompt and response bodies.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_OPERATIONAL_LOG
Config.Description: Operational log under the workspace.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_OPERATIONAL_LOG_MAX_BYTES
Config.Description: Active operational log cap in bytes. Default 524288.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_OPERATIONAL_LOG_RETENTION_MS
Config.Description: How long operational log segments are kept, in milliseconds. Default 604800000.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_STATE_PATH
Config.Description: State file under the workspace.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_TYPES_PATH
Config.Description: Gossip type catalog under the workspace.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_REFRESH_COUNT
Config.Description: Default refresh maximum, integer 1-10.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_REFRESH_BODY_MAX_BYTES
Config.Description: Maximum refresh JSON body in bytes, 1-1048576.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE_MS
Config.Description: Shutdown drain in milliseconds, integer 0-3600000. Default 5000.

Config.Name: GOSSIP_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: Station timezone.
